text_block_list.text:
Called over by Daiwa Scarlet, I ended up 
watching her dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four! One, two, three, 
four!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's good. But I'm sorry, that 
sort of surface-level praise isn't what 
I'm looking for.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What's important is 'whether I can be 
number one.' I want to turn a 100 into a 
1,000 to really leave them in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No matter how small it is, it's fine. 
Please, give me more of your candid 
opinions.
choice_data_list:
Let's keep dancing until we truly reach 
our limit.

Let's pay more attention to the expression 
in your fingertips.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: To the limit? What do you mean by—
choice_data_list:
Try to imagine what condition you'll be in 
after the race.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. A live performance is something 
you do after a race, once you've given it 
your absolute all.”

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
In short, you're saying it's important to 
keep the real race in mind, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't bad advice. Today, I'm going 
to push myself to the absolute limit...!

Daiwa Scarlet danced until sundown, 
finding new areas to improve along the 
way, and seemed thoroughly satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"True, I might have been focusing too much 
on the correctness of my overall body 
movements..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If I move my fingertips more like... 
quickly―― Yeah, this could work.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't bad advice. I'll give it a 
try, so watch me, okay?

Feeling the new sharpness added to her 
dancing, Daiwa Scarlet looked quite 
satisfied.
